fact: 1920年8月1日，甘地正式发起不合作运动，当日致信总督切尔姆斯福德并退还英王授予的凯撒-伊-欣德勋章；同日国大党元老巴尔·甘加达尔·蒂拉克去世，孟买等地举行罢工与游行。运动纲领包括放弃头衔与名誉职位、抵制政府学校与法院、抵制外国布、推广手纺土布，并以非暴力为前提。

sources.title: Mahatma Gandhi, Volume V: India Awakened（mkgandhi.org）
sources.quote: On 1 August 1920 the Khilafat movement was duly inaugurated, with Gandhiji returning to the Viceroy his Kaiser-e-Hind and other medals.

sources.title: Unit 12: Khilafat and Non-Cooperation Movements，eGyanKosh（IGNOU）
sources.quote: The non-cooperation movement was formally launched on 1 August 1920. That day was also marked by the death of Bal Gangadhar Tilak which witnessed strikes and processions to mourn the passing way of this great national leader.

fact: 1920年9月4日至6日，国大党在加尔各答举行特别会议，主席拉拉·拉伊帕特·拉伊，会议以多数通过不合作纲领，但把是否抵制立法会选举留交年会决定；同年12月的那格浦尔年会正式批准不合作纲领，把党的目标改为“以一切合法与和平手段获得自治（swaraj）”，并改组党的组织、把党员资格开放给缴纳4安纳会费的成年男女。

sources.title: Modern World History from AD 1500，University of Calicut（HIS3C02）
sources.quote: A special session of the all India Congress committee was held from 4th to 6th September under the president ship of Lajpat Rai at Calcutta... The resolution of Non cooperation was moved by Mahatma Gandhi... finally passed... This resolution came up for discussion and ratification at the regular annual session of the congress held in December 1920 at Nagpur.

sources.title: Non-Cooperation Movement，Banglapedia
sources.quote: At the Calcutta Session (September 1920) the programme of the movement was clearly stated... The Calcutta decision was endorsed at the Nagpur Session of the Congress (December 1920)... Congress membership was thrown open to all adult men and women on payment of 4 anas as subscription.

fact: 1919年4月13日的阿姆利则惨案在1920年进入调查与问责阶段：1920年5月26日，印度政府任命的亨特委员会（Disorders Inquiry Committee）公布报告，多数派认为戴尔准将在贾利安瓦拉巴格开枪“在原则上正当”，但未事先警告、射击时间过长；印度成员发表少数报告，认为戴尔的行为“非人道且不符合英国传统”。7月8日英国下议院就此辩论，以247票对37票支持陆军委员会不再给戴尔任何军职的决定。

sources.title: Hunter Committee，IndiaNetzone
sources.quote: On 26th May, the Hunter Report was published... The report concluded that Brigadier-General Dyer was justified in firing on the mob, though notice should have been given and its duration shortened. The Indian members of the Hunter Committee issued a minority report... On 8th July, the House of Commons debated the Dyer issue. It supported the decision of the Army Council that no further employment should be offered to Brigadier-General Dyer.

sources.title: Jallianwala Bagh massacre（Wikipedia）
sources.quote: After Churchill's speech in the House of Commons debate, MPs voted 247 to 37 against Dyer and in support of the Government.

sources.quote: They consider that General Dyer, through a mistaken belief that continued firing would be justified by the effect produced in other places, committed a grave error in firing too long... This opinion is not shared by the Indian members, who... stigmatizing his conduct as inhuman and un-British.

fact: 1920年10月31日，全印工会大会（AITUC）在孟买成立，101名代表出席，拉拉·拉伊帕特·拉伊任首任主席；成立时有64个附属工会、约14万会员。其直接契机是1919年国际劳工组织首次会议由印度政府自行指定代表、未与工会协商。

sources.title: All-India Trade Union Congress，Encyclopedia.com
sources.quote: The first session convened on 31 October 1920 with Lala Lajpat Rai as chairman. One hundred and one delegates attended the meeting... Overall, 64 unions in India were affiliated with the AITUC. The unions had a total membership of more than 140,000.

sources.title: All India Trade Union Congress，Archives of Indian Labour
sources.quote: founded on 31 October 1920 in Bombay (Mumbai)... At the beginning the AITUC had 64 affiliated unions with 1,40,000 members

fact: 1914至1921年，孟买市棉纺织工人平均工资上涨87%，艾哈迈达巴德上涨122%（孟买劳工局1923年数据），同期两地生活费涨幅相近。1920年1月，孟买纺织工人约15万人罢工并遭厂方锁厂，要求把工时由12小时减至9小时、每月15日按时发薪；罢工持续约一个月。

sources.title: Unions, Wages and Labour Productivity: Evidence from Indian Cotton Mills（Warwick Economics WP 753）
sources.quote: Between 1914 and 1921, wages rose by 87% in Bombay city and by 122% in Ahmedabad. (Bombay Labour Office, 1923)... 150,000 workers struck work for 12 days in 1919 followed by a general strike in 1920 that lasted for a month.

sources.title: Hazareesingh, 'The Quest for Urban Citizenship: Civic Rights, Public Opinion, and Colonial Resistance in Early Twentieth-Century Bombay'
sources.quote: another major strike broke out in January 1920: workers' demands had now escalated to include not only wages, but a reduction in working hours from twelve to nine and the regular payment of wages on the fifteenth of each month.

fact: 根据1919年《印度政府法》，1920年11月举行第一次省议会选举，在各省实行“双头制”（dyarchy）：教育、卫生、农业等“移交科目”由对省议会负责的印度部长管理，警察、财政等“保留科目”仍由总督任命的省督掌握；省议会选举权按财产与纳税资格限制。国大党抵制这次选举，约三分之二选民未投票。

sources.title: Modern World History from AD 1500，University of Calicut（HIS3C02）
sources.quote: Nearly 2/3 of the voter's abstained from the election to the councils held in November 1920.

sources.title: Non-Cooperation Movement，Banglapedia
sources.quote: The montagu-chelmsford report with its ill-considered scheme of dyarchy satisfied few.

fact: 1920年2月，印度货币委员会建议把卢比与黄金挂钩，定为一金镑的十分之一（即2先令）；同年9月《印度铸币法》确立2先令比率。但1920年下半年印度出口萎缩、贸易转为逆差，卢比从1920年初约2先令6便士跌至1920年12月约1先令5便士、1921年初低于1先令4便士；印度政府为维持汇率动用伦敦储备逾5,000万英镑后放弃。

sources.quote: Exchange persistently dropped from 2s. 6d. the rupee... to below 1s. 4d. in the early part of 1921... after they had diminished their gold holdings in this way by well over £50,000,000, they abandoned the struggle

sources.title: Royal Commission on Indian Currency and Finance（1926），GIPE
sources.quote: The Committee... recommended the stabilisa-tion of exchange at 2s.(gold)... The attempt to hold the rate at 2s.gold was not successful... This attempt also failed, and was abandoned on the 28th September.

fact: 1919—20年度印度新设股份公司的授权资本合计28.1亿卢比，而1914年全印注册公司的实缴资本仅7.5亿卢比；1920年初塔塔工业银行股票以高溢价被抢购，随后该行未能实现预期并倒闭。

sources.title: India，1926 Encyclopædia Britannica Supplement（Wikisource）
sources.quote: The aggregate authorised capital of new joint stock companies floated in the year 1919–20 alone was Rs. 281 crores, whereas the paid-up capital of all registered companies in existence in 1914 was only 75 crores. Subsequent liquidations were heavy. The most important of the new projects which failed to realise expectations was the Tata Industrial Bank, the shares of which were being bought eagerly in the early part of 1920 at a high premium.

fact: 1920年塔塔钢铁公司（TISCO）有约5.5万名工人（含2.3万名矿工）；1920与1921年，普通股股息16%、延期股股息200%；但1922年起除优先股外停止派息，1924年公司濒临破产，多亏Dorabji Tata以个人财产抵押取得贷款。到1930年代，TISCO成为英帝国最大钢铁厂。

sources.title: India，1926 Encyclopædia Britannica Supplement（Wikisource）
sources.quote: Dividends of 20% on the ordinary and 290% on the deferred shares were paid in 1917 and 1918; again in 1920 and 1921 ordinary shareholders got 16% and deferred shareholders 200%; but since 1922 no dividends have been paid except preference shares

sources.title: Tata History: When Nehru, Jinnah, and Bose allied to save steel company，India Today（2025-10-10）
sources.quote: By 1920, Tata Steel employed 55,000 workers, including 23,000 in the mines.

sources.title: Tata Iron & Steel Co. Ltd.，Encyclopedia.com
sources.quote: TISCO emerged from the 1930s, however, as the biggest steel plant in the British Empire.

fact: 印度进口外国棉布由1920—21年度的10.2亿卢比降至1921—22年度的5.7亿卢比；英国棉织品进口由12.92亿码降至9.55亿码。这一下降与不合作运动的抵制外国布、焚烧洋布与推广手纺土布同步。

sources.title: Unit 12: Khilafat and Non-Cooperation Movements，eGyanKosh（IGNOU）
sources.quote: The value of import of such merchandise fell from Rs. 102 crore in 1920-21 to Rs. 57 crore in 1921-22. Import of British cotton piecegoods declined from 1292 million yards in 1920-21 to 955 million in 1921-22.
